svg.title: Framebuffer console attachment across 21 boots
svg.desc: Dot plot, log scale: time of the first framebuffer console line in the kernel log for each of 21 boots. In the controlled pair (boots 4 to 11), v4ctl with the framebuffer on disp_cpu attaches at a mean 10.233 s (n=3) and v4 with disp_fe at 0.0600 s (n=5). Lower panel: power-domain errors per boot, 24 with disp_cpu, 20 with disp_fe, 0 from boot 12, where the DTB, kernel and initramfs changed together.
